channel.title: One Caribbean Television - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from One Caribbean Television (onecaribbeantelevision.com)

item.title: U.S. Offensive in Iran Sparks Escalation Abroad, War Powers Debate on Capitol Hill
item.description: Following the sweeping military offensive against Iran over the weekend, which resulted in the death of Iran’s supreme leader and dozens of top commanders, President Donald Trump said the operations will continue.

item.title: Puerto Rico’s Governor, Resident Commissioner Divided Over Statehood Push
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - We’ve heard President Trump talk about making Canada or Greenland the next US state, but what about Puerto Rico? The island’s Governor is in Capitol Hill this week advocating for Puerto Rico to become the next state but the island’s congressional member believes the Governor should focus on other issues than statehood.

item.title: Lawmakers Warn of Heightened Iran Terror Threat as DHS Shutdown Drags On
item.description: U.S. officials have ramped up counterterrorism efforts and have warned of a heightened threat environment. The partial government shutdown impacts the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) — which has been without funding, going on nearly three weeks.

item.title: Democrats Criticize Trump’s Iran Operations by Endangering Troops, Raising Costs for Americans
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - The general elections are just a few months away, and experts have told us the economy is always the top issue for voters. Republicans in congress and the President have touted their tax cuts legislation but Democrats are arguing this war with Iran will make things more costly here at home.

item.title: Kristi Noem out as DHS Secretary Amid Scrutiny; Trump Taps Sen. Markwayne Mullin as Replacement
item.description: The former South Dakota governor — chosen by the president to lead the Department of Homeland Security — has faced growing scrutiny over her conduct, including reports of a romantic relationship with a top adviser and her handling of a major immigration crackdown in Minneapolis.

item.title: House Rejects Resolution to Limit Trump’s Authority on Iran Military Action
item.description: Thursday evening, House lawmakers voted down a resolution that would have limited President Donald Trump’s authority to pursue further military action against Iran without — without congressional approval.

item.title: Renewed Push to Transition Puerto Rico from NAP to SNAP Benefits
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Puerto Rico’s Governor and a handful of Senate Democrats said the territory’s residents have been treated differently when it comes to receiving federal food benefits. There’s a renwed effort in Congress to get SNAP benefits for Puerto Ricans.

item.title: USVI LEPC Cleared of Federal “High-risk” Status After More Than a Decade of Oversight, Gov. Bryan Weighs In
item.description: The Virgin Islands Law Enforcement Planning Commission (LEPC) is no longer considered “high-risk” by the U.S. Department of Justice, ending a period of heightened oversight that began in 2012. The designation stemmed from concerns raised by federal investigators about grant management tied to events over a decade ago.

item.title: Gov. Bryan Looking Forward to FEMA Assistance, Nearly $28 Million Will Aid Hurricane Recovery Projects in USVI
item.description: The Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) recently approved nearly $28 million in disaster recovery funding for the U.S. Virgin Islands to help repair damage caused by Hurricane Maria.

item.title: Expert: Iran’s New Supreme Leader Sends “Political Statement” to US, Israel and Iranians
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Motjaba Khamenei, the son of Iran’s former Supreme Leader, Ali Khamenei, who was killed in the US-Israeli strikes, has been named as the new Supreme Leader. Experts said it’s a political statement to the US, Israel and Iranians who thought there could be a shift in leadership.
